steps.name: tool-jwt-decoder
steps.summary: Created jwtDecoder.ts (decodeJwt + explainStandardClaims, 19 unit tests), JwtDecoderTool.tsx (client component, no localStorage/sessionStorage, token not in analytics payload), page.tsx for /developer/jwt-decoder (EN/KO), and tools-config entry (disclaimerType: none, relatedToolIds: [], addedAt: 2026-07-23). steps.name: tool-json-to-sql

steps.name: json-formatter-enhancements
steps.summary: Added 'Convert to SQL →' button to JsonFormatterTool.tsx (writes sessionStorage key 'json-formatter-to-sql:payload', navigates to /developer/json-to-sql with locale awareness, uses existing 'calculate' event, no cross-import). Added 'json-to-sql' to json-formatter relatedToolIds in tools-config.ts (json-to-sql already had json-formatter). Lint, 545 tests, and build pass.
